dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Attach
description: Uploads the files a project's packaging targets wrote to the GitHub release of the project's tag at the checked-out commit through gh release upload --clobber, or where GitHub holds no release of that tag, which gh api graphql reads, creates it with those files through gh release create --verify-tag, the tag nx release made from release.releaseTag.pattern or one made by hand, fails where that read fails, and uploads nothing where HEAD holds no tag of the project, a dry run previewing every project
